{{Top|leg}}
'''Quadrant Q-1''' was a section of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where the temporary quarters of former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jax Pavan]] and his companions was located. They stayed there while investigating the murder of the [[light sculptor]] [[Ves Volette]].<ref name="sos">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>
